∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p n : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ξ : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p) {δ : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ ξ δ →
    ∀ (hp : 1 ≤ p),
      (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) j j = 1) →
        ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ),
          A * A.transpose = RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) →
            ∀ {c C : ℝ},
              0 < c →
                c ≤ 1 →
                  1 ≤ C →
                    (∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p),
                        s.faces = Finset.univ →
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.exceptionalBandwidthConstant C * δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
                            RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p * s.bandwidth ^ 2 < 1 / 4 →
                              ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1,
                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.ExceptionalNormalizedMatrixEstimates hp s μ ξ A C
                                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicBoundaryCoefficient μ ξ A) t) →
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.rectangleDistance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ) A ≤
                        RectangleCLTArxivV1.exceptionalCoreConstant C *
                          min 1
                            (δ * (RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) *
                                √(RectangleCLTArxivV1.exceptionalCutoffLog c) +
                              δ ^ (2 / 3) *
                                  (RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianMaximumMean A * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) ^ (2 / 3) *
                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.exceptionalCorrelationBudget
                                    (RectangleCLT.covariance μ (RectangleCLT.sumVector ξ)) c ^
                                  (1 / 3))
